action_args.justification: The series is strongly trend-dominated (trend strength 0.98) with moderate seasonality and non-stationary structure. Model ranking is unstable across the 3 validation windows (Kendall tau -0.162) and errors are highly correlated (mean 0.808, 9 redundant groups), so no subset or re-weighting can reliably exploit a stable edge. The leader (inverse-error weighted full pool) already captures the benefit of the two clearly superior models (THETA, ETS) while diluting the correlated-error tail, and its margin over the plain mean is within noise given only 3 windows. Accepting the seed is the statistically sound choice.
